policies.name: Business Owner's Policy
policies.description: Your BUSINESS LIABILITY COVERAGE helps protect and defend your business from covered claims alleging that you damaged someone's property, injured them or defamed them.
policies.fullDescription: Your Business Owner's Policy provides comprehensive protection for your business, defending against covered claims alleging property damage, bodily injury, or personal and advertising injury. It includes coverage for medical expenses, damage to premises rented to you, and features like Blanket Additional Insured by Contract and Technology Services Coverage Extension.
keyFeatures: Protects against claims alleging property damage or bodily injury.
Covers defense costs for covered claims.
Includes Medical Expenses coverage.
Coverage for damage to premises rented to you.
Waiver of Subrogation - Blanket.
Blanket Additional Insured by Contract.
Technology Services Coverage Extension.

covered: A customer slips and falls in your office, sustaining an injury.
Your employee accidentally damages a client's property during a service visit.
A competitor sues you for libel or slander in your advertising.
A fire in your rented office space causes damage to the landlord's property.
notCovered: Claims arising from professional errors or omissions.
Data breaches involving personally identifiable information.
Claims related to employment practices (e.g., discrimination).
Damage to your own business property.

policies.name: Data Breach
policies.description: Your DATA BREACH COVERAGE helps protect and defend you if the personally identifiable information you hold about clients, partners and employees is lost or stolen.
policies.fullDescription: Your Data Breach coverage protects and defends your business if personally identifiable information (PII) held about clients, partners, and employees is lost or stolen. It covers response expenses, defense and liability for claims, and includes sub-limits for business income, extra expenses, and extortion threats related to data breaches.
keyFeatures: Covers expenses for responding to a data breach.
Provides defense and liability coverage for data breach claims.
Includes coverage for business income and extra expenses due to a data breach.
Covers extortion expenses and ransom payments related to data threats.
Retroactive Date: 03/31/2026.
Extended Reporting Period: 30 days.

covered: Costs associated with notifying customers after a data breach.
Legal defense costs if a client sues due to their personal data being compromised.
Loss of income due to business interruption caused by a data breach.
Ransom paid to prevent the release of stolen data.
notCovered: Claims arising from professional negligence unrelated to data privacy.
Intentional acts of data theft by the insured.
Data breaches occurring before the retroactive date.

policies.name: Employment Practices Liability Insurance
policies.description: Your EMPLOYMENT PRACTICES LIABILITY INSURANCE (EPLI) helps protect and defend your business from employment-related covered claims.
policies.fullDescription: Your Employment Practices Liability Insurance (EPLI) helps protect and defend your business from employment-related covered claims including but not limited to, discrimination, sexual harassment or wrongful termination brought by your employees or applicants. It also includes coverage for wage and hour defense costs.
keyFeatures: Protects against claims of discrimination, sexual harassment, or wrongful termination.
Covers defense costs for employment-related claims.
Includes coverage for wage and hour defense costs.
Claims-made coverage.
Retroactive Date: 03/31/2026.

covered: Legal defense for a claim of wrongful termination by a former employee.
Settlement costs for a sexual harassment lawsuit.
Defense costs for a wage and hour violation claim.
notCovered: Claims arising from bodily injury or property damage.
Intentional criminal acts by the employer.
Claims occurring before the retroactive date.
Claims not reported within the policy period or extended reporting period.

policies.name: FailSafe Technology Errors or Omissions Liability
policies.description: Your Failsafe Enterprise Liability Policy helps protect and defend your business if a customer claims that you were negligent in providing them with professional technology services, or handling their data which caused them financial harm.
policies.fullDescription: Your FailSafe Technology Errors or Omissions Liability Policy protects and defends your business if a customer claims negligence in providing professional technology services or handling their data, causing financial harm. This claims-made policy includes coverage for professional liability, third-party data privacy, network security liability, media liability, intellectual property, and a personal injury endorsement.
keyFeatures: Covers claims of professional negligence in technology services.
Protects against financial harm caused by handling client data.
Includes Third-Party Data Privacy coverage.
Covers Network Security Liability.
Includes Media Liability and Intellectual Property coverage.
Personal Injury Endorsement included.
Claims-made coverage.
Retroactive Date: 03/31/2026.

covered: A client sues for financial loss due to an error in your software development.
Negligent handling of client data leads to a privacy violation lawsuit.
A cyberattack on your systems causes a denial of service for a client.
A claim of copyright infringement related to content you published.
notCovered: Bodily injury or property damage claims (covered by GL).
Losses occurring before the retroactive date or after the policy period.

considerations: EPLI and Technology E&O are claims-made policies, requiring claims to be made and reported within the policy period or extended reporting period.
Technology E&O includes a $2,500 retention (deductible) per wrongful act.
Data Breach coverage has specific sub-limits for business income, extra expenses, and extortion threats.
The quote is based on provided information and subject to change upon policy issuance or audit.
Defense costs for EPLI and Technology E&O are included within the limits of liability, potentially reducing available funds for indemnity.
coverageStrengths: Comprehensive protection for technology businesses, combining general liability, data breach, EPLI, and technology E&O.
Robust Data Breach coverage including response expenses, defense, and liability.
Specialized FailSafe Technology E&O covers professional negligence, data privacy, network security, media, and intellectual property.
Employment Practices Liability Insurance (EPLI) included, addressing critical HR-related risks.
High aggregate limits for Business Liability and Technology E&O provide substantial financial protection.
